## Pull request overview Adds a hardened container release pipeline with SBOM/provenance attestations and vulnerability-gated promotion. **Changes:** - Adds a multi-stage Docker build using hardened Node.js images. - Adds dependency-install protections and build exclusions. - Adds a GitHub Actions workflow to build, scan, and promote images. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 5 out of 5 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `README.md` | Documents local setup and supply-chain releases. | | `Dockerfile` | Builds a non-root production image. | | `.npmrc` | Configures dependency-install restrictions. | | `.github/workflows/release.yml` | Builds, attests, scans, and promotes images. | | `.dockerignore` | Excludes unnecessary build-context files. |

## Pull request overview

Copilot reviewed 7 out of 7 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.




<details>
<summary>Suppressed comments (3)</summary>

**.github/workflows/release.yml:196**
* The comments endpoint returns only its first page by default. Once the existing SIP report is older than the first 30 PR comments, this lookup misses it and posts a duplicate report rather than updating it. Add pagination so the marker is searched across all comments.
```
          COMMENT_ID=$(gh api \
            "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/${PR_NUMBER}/comments" \
            --jq '.[] | select(.body | contains("<!-- sip-trivy-report -->")) | .id' \
            | head -n 1)
```
**scripts/validate-lockfile-age.mjs:33**
* A present but malformed timestamp makes `Date.parse()` return `NaN`; because `NaN > cutoff` is false, that dependency passes even though this validator is intended to fail closed on unverifiable publish times. Treat an invalid parsed timestamp as a violation.
```
  const publishedAt = metadata.time?.[version];
  if (!publishedAt) {
    violations.push(`${name}@${version}: publish time unavailable`);
  } else if (Date.parse(publishedAt) > cutoff) {
    violations.push(`${name}@${version}: published ${publishedAt}`);
```
**docs/pr-2-review-comparison.md:100**
* This resolution says PR events do not receive registry credentials or publish images, but the implemented workflow deliberately gives same-repository PRs DHI credentials plus `packages: write` and pushes a candidate image. Update the resolution to distinguish credential-free fork/dependency CI from the privileged same-repository container jobs.
```
- Trigger CI for pull requests targeting `main`, validating the dependency
  cooldown, locked install, application build, and tests without exposing
  registry credentials or publishing an image from the PR event.
```
</details>

## Pull request overview

Copilot reviewed 7 out of 7 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.




<details>
<summary>Suppressed comments (4)</summary>

**scripts/validate-lockfile-age.mjs:46**
* A non-empty but invalid publication timestamp produces `NaN`, making the age comparison false and allowing unverifiable metadata through despite the fail-closed policy. Parse once and treat an invalid date the same as a missing timestamp.
```
      const publishedAt = metadata.time?.[version];
      if (!publishedAt) {
        violations.push(`${name}@${version}: publish time unavailable`);
      } else if (Date.parse(publishedAt) > cutoff) {
        violations.push(`${name}@${version}: published ${publishedAt}`);
```
**.github/workflows/release.yml:208**
* GitHub Actions runs this pipeline with `pipefail`; once `head` reads the first match, it can close the pipe while `gh api --paginate` is still fetching/writing later pages, causing a SIGPIPE and failing report updates on PRs with enough comments. Slurp all pages and select the first marker in jq instead of truncating the stream.
```
          COMMENT_ID=$(gh api \
            "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/${PR_NUMBER}/comments" \
            --paginate \
            --jq '.[] | select(.body | contains("<!-- sip-trivy-report -->")) | .id' \
            | head -n 1)
```
**README.md:99**
* The documented exception path does not work with the new validator: `min-release-age-exclude` affects npm resolution, but this script independently flags every version newer than five days and never reads exclusions. Either implement the same narrowly scoped exclusions in the validator or document that no override is supported.
```
No cooldown exclusions are configured. If a required security update is less
than five days old, review it and add a narrowly scoped
`min-release-age-exclude` entry rather than weakening the policy globally.
```
**docs/pr-2-review-comparison.md:100**
* This resolution contradicts the workflow: same-repository PRs enter `container-attestations`, receive DHI/GHCR credentials through `sip-publish`, and push a candidate image. Only fork PRs stop after credential-free validation. Clarify that distinction so this security record does not claim all PRs avoid credentials and publication.
```
- Trigger CI for pull requests targeting `main`, validating the dependency
  cooldown, locked install, application build, and tests without exposing
  registry credentials or publishing an image from the PR event.
```
</details>
